initialWindow: navigation to load + 2000ms, no scroll or interaction; requests completed within window
networkMethod: CDP Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength, response cache provenance; disk/memory cache transfer zero; request completion inside window; transfer includes HTTP response headers where CDP reports them, excludes transport-layer overhead
decodedMethod: Aggregate uses CDP Network.dataReceived dataLength; ResourceTiming decodedBodySize and navigation decodedBodySize are additionally retained in raw rows and never added to CDP totals. Warm cached dataReceived can undercount logical decoded resources; cross-origin ResourceTiming requires TAO.
limitations: co-located ARM Docker; CDP simulated network and CPU; no deployed CDN/real-user metrics
